name: Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria
native: الإدارة الذاتية لشمال وشرق سوريا (al-Idāra adh-Dhātiyya li-Shamāl wa-Sharq Sūriyā)
Rêveberiya Xweser a Bakur û Rojhilatê Sûriyê
alt: Democratic Federation of Rojava - Northern Syria
Democratic Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria
wikipedia: Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria

predecessors.name: Syria
predecessors.text: the three mainly Kurdish areas from which 'the government responded ... by withdrawing its military' in mid-2012: Kobani, Amuda and Afrin, with parts of Hasakah and Qamishli

ledger.x: July 2012: the Kurdish areas of northern Syria pass to the YPG.
January 2014: the three areas declare their autonomy as cantons.
late December 2015: the SDF takes the Tishrin Dam and crosses the Euphrates.
6-12 August 2016: Manbij falls to the SDF.
August 2016: Hasakah city passes entirely to the Jazira canton.
2017: the SDF holds most of Raqqa governorate before the city.
8 September-25 November 2017: Deir ez-Zor north and east of the Euphrates.
24 March 2018: the operation ends with Afrin in Turkish-SNA hands.
6 September 2018: the name Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria.
23 March 2019: Baghuz Fawqani falls, the last ISIL ground.
October 2019: Tell Abyad and Ras al-Ayn pass to Turkey and the SNA.
December 2023: the region adopts a new constitution and the name DAANES (Democratic Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria).
9 December 2024: Manbij falls to the SNA.

wars.name: Siege of Kobani
wars.outcome: ISIL attacked on 15 September 2014 and took 350 villages; the YPG expelled it from the city on 26-27 January 2015 and had 332 of the 350 villages back by 17 April 2015.

wars.name: Tell Abyad offensive (2015)
wars.outcome: 31 May to 10 July 2015: the YPG and allies took the Tell Abyad crossing on 15 June and the town on 16 June, linking the Kobani and Jazira cantons; Ayn Issa changed hands on 23 June, 6 July and 8 July.

wars.name: Al-Hawl offensive
wars.outcome: 31 October to 30 November 2015: the SDF captured al-Hawl on 13 November and 240+ towns and villages.

wars.name: Al-Shaddadi offensive
wars.outcome: 16 to 24 February 2016: the SDF captured Shaddadi on 19 February, 315+ villages and 2,400+ km2, ISIL's last stronghold in Hasakah.

wars.name: Manbij offensive (2016)
wars.outcome: 31 May to 12 August 2016: the SDF crossed the Euphrates, took 105 villages and farms by 14 June and Manbij city on 12 August; Turkey's Operation Euphrates Shield began on 24 August to stop the Rojava regions uniting.

wars.name: Battle of Raqqa (2017)
wars.outcome: The campaign began on 6 November 2016; the city battle ran from 6 June to 17 October 2017 with US airstrikes and up to 500 US special forces; victory declared 20 October.

wars.name: Deir ez-Zor campaign (2017-2019)
wars.outcome: Operation Jazeera Storm from 8 September 2017; Hajin on 14 December 2018; Baghuz on 23 March 2019.

wars.name: Operation Olive Branch
wars.outcome: 20 January to 24 March 2018: Turkey and the SNA took Afrin District (about 2,000 km2, 282 settlements); Afrin city fell on 18 March.

wars.name: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria
wars.outcome: 9-22 October 2019 (Operation Peace Spring): Turkey and the SNA took 68 settlements including Ras al-Ayn and Tell Abyad; ceasefire 17 October and the Sochi memorandum of 22 October.

certainty.note: Front lines and administrative claims, not surveyed borders; the Euphrates line in Deir ez-Zor (2017 onward) and the 32 km Peace Spring strip (2019) are the firmest.
